# Zye.AI

> Zye.AI is a small, independent AI studio making practical tools that help individuals build with AI. Our products are for people, not companies.

## Products
- [The Build Brief](https://buildbrief.zye.ai/): free AI brief for people who build with AI (AI models, agents, vibe coding, tech and security). Join the list. First issue coming soon.
- [Unbroke](https://unbroke.zye.ai/): fixes broken vibe-coded apps. Agents diagnose, a human reviews every fix. Pricing and checkout are coming soon.
